evidence_label: observed deployment capability; least-privilege scope not resolvable without token-management permission
conclusion: The existing GitHub Actions Cloudflare token successfully provisioned/deployed the dedicated birdahead Worker, D1 and R2 during the release, so it has at least Workers Scripts, D1 and R2 permissions. A resource-scoped token was not available to substitute without changing owner-managed secrets; no token was rotated or weakened. The account-scoped local D1 backup token was used only for an explicitly authorized private export, never for deployment.
follow_up: Owner should replace the deployment secret with a token restricted to the birdahead Worker, birdahead D1 and birdahead-private R2, then rerun the gated release and rollback check.
